question: What are the total sales by product category?
SQL: SELECT cat_id, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY cat_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC

question: Which store had the highest total sales across all time?
SQL: SELECT store_id, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the total sales per state?
SQL: SELECT state_id, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY state_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC

question: What is the monthly sales trend across all stores?
SQL: SELECT T2.month, SUM(T1.sales) AS total_sales FROM sales AS T1 JOIN calendar AS T2 ON T1.d = T2.d GROUP BY T2.month ORDER BY T2.month

question: Which department had the highest average daily sales?
SQL: SELECT dept_id, AVG(sales) AS avg_daily_sales FROM sales GROUP BY dept_id ORDER BY avg_daily_sales DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are total sales broken down by day of the week?
SQL: SELECT T2.weekday, SUM(T1.sales) AS total_sales FROM sales AS T1 JOIN calendar AS T2 ON T1.d = T2.d GROUP BY T2.weekday ORDER BY total_sales DESC

question: How do total sales compare across years?
SQL: SELECT T2.year, SUM(T1.sales) AS total_sales FROM sales AS T1 JOIN calendar AS T2 ON T1.d = T2.d GROUP BY T2.year ORDER BY T2.year

question: Which items have the highest total sales volume?
SQL: SELECT item_id, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the total sales per Walmart week number?
SQL: SELECT T2.wm_yr_wk, SUM(T1.sales) AS weekly_sales FROM sales AS T1 JOIN calendar AS T2 ON T1.d = T2.d GROUP BY T2.wm_yr_wk ORDER BY T2.wm_yr_wk

question: Which store and category combination has the most sales on SNAP benefit days?
SQL: SELECT T1.store_id, T1.cat_id, SUM(T1.sales) AS snap_sales FROM sales AS T1 JOIN calendar AS T2 ON T1.d = T2.d WHERE T2.snap_CA = 1 OR T2.snap_TX = 1 OR T2.snap_WI = 1 GROUP BY T1.store_id, T1.cat_id ORDER BY snap_sales DESC LIMIT 1
